sections.text:
Achievements and Responsibilities:
Developed and maintained Java-based applications, demonstrating proficiency in Java programming. Leveraged Spring Boot framework to build scalable and efficient software solutions. Designed and implemented robust, secure, and high-performance software systems. Participated in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to coding standards. Conducted unit testing and debugging to identify and resolve software defects. Contributed to the documentation of software designs, technical specifications, and user manuals. Worked on UPI-Wallet, Kotak UPI, Batch Processing, Event Ticketing module in Mobile Assist platform.
Technologies: Spring Boot, MySQL, Core Java Clients: Dhani Finance Co. & Paul Merchant Description: UPI-PPI Wallet is a Preapproved transaction and there is no Core banking system. When the transaction is initiated then the amount will be debited and NPCI will give direct credit to the corresponding customer or merchant.
Technologies: Core Java, Spring boot, Hibernate, REST API, Oracle Description: Developed and implemented Kotak UPI banking financial project, a robust solution for Kotak Bank based on the Unified Payments Interface (UPI). Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design system architecture, and develop secure Java based applications. Implemented banking functionalities such as fund transfers, bill payments, and balance inquiries, ensuring compliance with banking regulations and security standards. Designed and integrated RESTful APIs for seamless interaction with third-party payment gateways and financial institutions. Utilized Java frameworks (Spring Boot, Hibernate) for efficient development and maintenance. Conducted rigorous testing, debugging, and code reviews for high-quality deliverables. Assisted in deployment, performance tuning, and optimization. Stayed updated with industry regulations and emerging technologies for continuous improvement.
